command: Ghidra ExportIkc.java and ExportIkcFlow.java; python reassemble.py ORIGINAL ZIG; python recover.py ORIGINAL; python -B s17/check-dispatch.py ORIGINAL; python -B s21/check-dispatch.py ORIGINAL
scope: Union of original PE entries and recorded Ghidra functions, direct call expansion, call/reference and CHAININFO relation, byte comparison of certified editable source after applying COFF relocations.
limitations: Byte comparison covers the recorded editable spans. Fifteen indirect references retain an unbound ultimate callback destination; see s17/dispatch.json and s21/dispatch.json for initial PE state and entry-path conditions. The direct RIP-relative scan covers recorded original instruction ranges. Runtime behavior and full-file acceptance require separate evidence.
